say:1:1521632001:0.text: Thanks for helping me find this stone. It's perfect for my father's grave.
say:1:1521632001:0.source_cn: 谢谢你们帮我找的石头。它很适合用来做墓碑。

say:2:1521632002:0.text: Please wait with me while I work... I'll be done soon.
say:2:1521632002:0.source_cn: 请等我一会……我很快就能做完。

narration:4:1521632003:0.text: With slow, deliberate strikes, Warner silently carves into the rock. Each tap of his tool shapes the cold stone into a grave marker.
narration:4:1521632003:0.source_cn: 维尔纳沉默地在石头上敲敲打打，将它打磨成墓碑的形状。

narration:5:1521632004:0.text: Finally, he carves the name "Gregory" into the tombstone and sets it upright where the creature fell.
narration:5:1521632004:0.source_cn: 最后，他在墓碑上刻下了“格雷格”这个名字，将它竖立在怪...

say:6:1521632005:0.text: Gregory was my father's first name.
say:6:1521632005:0.source_cn: 格雷格……这是我父亲的名字。

say:7:1521632006:0.text: Our family's been the stonemasons of Tuttleton for generations. We've carved everything... from temple statues and religious ornaments down to little stone charms for kids to wear.
say:7:1521632006:0.source_cn: 我们家族世代都是图塔镇的石匠。大到教堂和各类祭祀的神像...

say:8:1521632007:0.text: Mason is our family name. That's why people in town used to call my father "Old Mason".
say:8:1521632007:0.source_cn: “石艺”是我们家族的姓氏。镇上的人也一直管我老爹叫“老...

say:9:1521632008:0.text: His real name, Gregory, seemed to have been forgotten long ago...
say:9:1521632008:0.source_cn: 真正属于他自己的名字——格雷格，好像早就被人遗忘了……

choice_prompt:10:1521632008.text: His real name, Gregory, seemed to have been forgotten long ago...
choice_prompt:10:1521632008.source_cn: 真正属于他自己的名字——格雷格，好像早就被人遗忘了……

say:11:1521632009:0.text: Yes, Gregory will remain here, but Old Mason...
say:11:1521632009:0.source_cn: 格雷格会留在这里……但老石艺还不能。

say:12:1521632011:0.text: I used to hate it when people called him "Old Mason". It sounded so plain and rough, like an unpolished rock.
say:12:1521632011:0.source_cn: 我曾经很抵触“老石艺”这个名字。我嫌弃它一点也不好听，...

say:13:1521632012:0.text: But just now, watching my father carve into those stones, seeing all those scratches... I suddenly understood something.
say:13:1521632012:0.source_cn: 但刚刚，我看着老爹雕石头地样子，看着那些被划得乱七八糟...

say:14:1521632013:0.text: He was proud of what people called him.
say:14:1521632013:0.source_cn: 他以这个名字为傲……不是吗？

say:15:1521632014:0.text: So, I'll carry on the name "Old Mason". I'll make my work spread far and wide so that wherever it's known, his memory lives on.
say:15:1521632014:0.source_cn: 所以，我会继承“老石艺”这个名字。这样，如果有更多人知...

say:16:1521632015:0.text: Everyone will know that my father was the best stonemason in the world.
say:16:1521632015:0.source_cn: 我的老爹……他是世界上最好的石匠。
